A machine-readable evidence report records exact source/candidate/fixture identities, workloads, timeout, environment, correctness oracles, latency distributions, memory and storage bounds, and scale results including B-021 or an explicit blocked row.

Schema creation, forward migration, interrupted migration recovery, mapped text-archive import, unknown-mapping rejection, and idempotent reconciliation execute through the candidate-neutral public boundary.
FF-GATE-ARCH-001, FF-GATE-RUNTIME-001 prerequisite ceiling, FF-GATE-DEEP-001, FF-GATE-PR-001, secret scan, and independent adversarial reviews pass on the same committed source and evidence manifest.

Build, test, verification, package, runtime, fixtures, subprocess plans, and delegated work contain no Python, yt-dlp, yt-dlp companion package, executable asset, wrapper, fallback, sidecar, plugin, service, or downloaded solver dependency.
